title: Cron auth fails closed off Vercel and the vitals endpoint is rate limited
detail:
An unset CRON_SECRET outside production lets 40+ cron routes through; /api/vitals is an unauthenticated service-role insert with no per-IP limit. Also add a header presence gate (see headers-gate).

2026-10-26 REPAIR LANDED as SEC-011 (#3932): cron auth now allows an unset secret only in development and test, and /api/vitals has a shared rate ceiling, verified by scripts/probes/sec-cron-vitals.mjs. This row's probe looks for VERCEL_ENV or ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_CRON in cron-auth.ts, which the repair does not use. The repair is done; the probe is unchanged and still fails, so this row stays open until Daniel rules on replacing it or the probe is re-pointed.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
